description: Consolidated flat catalogue of all 30 services in the UK commercial bank's target architecture. Includes the 17 domain services, 6 cross-cutting shared services, and 7 foundation platform services from the foundation technical service files, plus the 7 new observability and security services introduced in Step 5 (SVC-107 through SVC-113). Each entry records classification, capability mappings, owner team, SLA, API style, data store, tier, and status. Total: 37 services across all tiers.

services.name: Retail Banking Core
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (primary ledger) + Redis (real-time balance cache)
services.notes: Core retail ledger. Publishes AccountOpened, BalanceUpdated, LoanOriginated events. Hard dependency on SVC-050 (KYC clearance) and SVC-052 (credit decisions). Buy candidate: Thought Machine Vault / Mambu / 10x SuperCore.

services.name: Mortgage Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (mortgage lifecycle records) + S3 (valuation and legal documents via SVC-054)
services.notes: MCOB-regulated mortgage origination through to account management. Hard dependency on SVC-052 for AIP. CHAPS drawdown via SVC-009. HM Land Registry integration.

services.name: Credit Card Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (card accounts, statement cycles) + dedicated PCI DSS CDE datastore
services.data_residency: UK only (PCI DSS CDE with UK residency)
services.notes: PCI DSS CDE-scoped. Sub-100ms authorisation path via gRPC to SVC-013 (Fraud). Hard dependency on SVC-011 (Card Processing) for BIN management and scheme connectivity. Section 75 liability management.

services.name: Insurance Distribution Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (policy records) + S3 (policy documents via SVC-054)
services.notes: FCA-authorised insurance intermediary. ICOBS and Insurance Distribution Directive. T4 overlay — dependent on SVC-001 for customer profile. Bank does not underwrite; it distributes. Buy candidate: white-labelled insurance distribution platform.

services.name: Commercial Banking Core
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (commercial ledger, facility records) + Redis (real-time position cache)
services.notes: Commercial customer ledger. Business accounts and lending. nCino (Salesforce) as commercial lending origination buy candidate. Publishes FacilityApproved, DrawdownCompleted events. Hard dependency on SVC-050 (KYB clearance) and SVC-051 (sanctions).

services.name: Trade Finance Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (LC and guarantee records) + document repository via SVC-054
services.notes: ETDA 2023 electronic trade documents. SWIFT MT700-series messaging. UCP 600/URDG 758 document examination. Hard dependency on SVC-051 (sanctions screening for LC counterparties). Buy candidate: Finastra Trade Innovation or Surecomp RIVO.

services.name: Treasury Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (ISDA/EMIR trade records, cash pool structures) + TimescaleDB (intraday position time-series)
services.notes: Notional pooling, physical sweeping, FX products, ISDA/CSA documentation, EMIR UK reporting. Kyriba partnership model: bank integrates its products into Kyriba via API. MiFID II appropriateness assessments for derivative clients.

services.name: Merchant Acquiring Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (merchant records, settlement) + dedicated PCI DSS CDE datastore
services.notes: Bank retains acquiring licence and merchant relationship; Worldpay/Fiserv bureau handles scheme processing. Sub-100ms authorisation via gRPC. PSR MR22/1.7 scheme fee transparency records. Hard dependency on SVC-013 (CNP fraud scoring).

services.name: Domestic Payments Service
services.api_style: gRPC (payment execution path) + REST/OpenAPI (management and reporting)
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (payment ledger, CoP records) + Kafka (payment event stream via SVC-102)
services.data_residency: UK only (Pay.UK and Bank of England participant rules)
services.notes: Direct FPS and BACS participant (via Vocalink). CHAPS Bank of England RT2 direct participant. Confirmation of Payee (CoP) integrated. APP fraud reimbursement up to £85k (PSR PS23/3 from Oct 2024). Hard blocking dependencies on SVC-051 (sanctions) and SVC-013 (fraud) in the payment execution path. Buy candidate: Form3 cloud-native platform.

services.name: International Payments Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (SWIFT message records, nostro positions) + TimescaleDB (intraday FX rates)
services.notes: SWIFT CBPR+ ISO 20022 MX mandatory from November 2025. FATF travel rule data. SWIFT gpi status tracking. Hard dependency on SVC-051 for all cross-border beneficiary screening. Buy candidate: SWIFT SAA Cloud + Volante ISO 20022 translation.

services.name: Card Processing Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (BIN management, dispute records) + PCI DSS CDE datastore (cardholder data)
services.data_residency: UK only (PCI DSS CDE cardholder data)
services.notes: BIN management, real-time Visa/Mastercard authorisation, clearing/settlement, dispute management (120-day cycle). Hard dependency on SVC-013 (fraud scoring in authorisation path — sub-100ms). Buy candidate: Marqeta / Thredd (formerly GPS). Strong buy — bank does not maintain direct scheme processing.

services.name: Risk Engine Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (model inventory, ICAAP records) + Data Platform (SVC-104) for batch calculations
services.notes: IRB PD/LGD/EAD models, IFRS 9 ECL provisioning, FRTB Sensitivity-Based Approach, operational risk Basel Standardised, COREP calculation. PRA SS1/23 model risk governance. CRO SM&CR accountability. Buy candidate: SAS Risk Intelligence Suite / Moody's Analytics RiskFoundation.

services.name: Fraud Detection Service
services.api_style: gRPC (real-time scoring path) + REST/OpenAPI (alert management and reporting)
services.data_store: Feature store (SVC-104 Data Platform) + PostgreSQL (fraud case management)
services.notes: Sub-100ms real-time fraud scoring via gRPC. Hard blocking dependency for SVC-009 (FPS/CHAPS), SVC-011 (card auth), SVC-008 (CNP). APP fraud PSR reimbursement case management. Cifas FNIF reporting. Strong buy: Featurespace ARIC / Quantexa / NetGuardians.

services.name: KYC/AML Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (CDD records, client risk scores) + S3 (identity documents via SVC-054)
services.data_residency: UK only (MLRO accountability records, POCA-protected SAR data)
services.notes: MLRO personal accountability (POCA 2002, SMCR SMF17). Perpetual KYC — event-triggered refresh. AML transaction monitoring (Napier AI). NCA UKFIU SAR submissions. ComplyAdvantage/Refinitiv for PEP/adverse media data. Onfido/Encompass for identity and corporate KYC.

services.name: Compliance Core Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (regulatory return metadata, ROPA, DPIA records) + Data Platform (SVC-104) for aggregated regulatory data
services.notes: COREP, FINREP, PRA 110, FCA regulatory returns. Consumer Duty outcomes monitoring. SM&CR accountability map. UK GDPR ROPA, DPIA, SAR handling. Communications surveillance (Behavox). Buy candidates: AxiomSL for reporting; OneTrust for GDPR.

services.name: Wealth Platform Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (portfolio records, suitability assessments) + FNZ custody platform (via integration)
services.notes: Integrated banking-and-wealth proposition. MiFID II suitability (COBS 9A). SDR ESG labels (PS23/16). MiFID II transaction reporting. EMIR derivatives reporting. Buy candidates: FNZ/SEI for platform custody; Wealth Dynamix CRM; BlackRock Aladdin Wealth for portfolio analytics; Voyant for financial planning.

services.name: Digital Channels Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (consent records, TPP onboarding) + Redis (session cache)
services.data_residency: UK only (customer interaction data, consent records)
services.notes: OBIE Open Banking API programme (CMA Order obligations). AISP/PISP/VRP/cVRP. TPP consent lifecycle. Customer communications orchestration. WCAG 2.1 AA. Hard dependency on SVC-100 (customer SCA) and SVC-013 (APP fraud warnings in payment journey). Buy candidates: TrueLayer for Open Banking connectivity; Twilio/MessageBird for delivery infrastructure; Bud for transaction categorisation.

services.name: Customer Onboarding Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (onboarding workflow state, KYC clearance records)
services.data_residency: UK only (MLRO accountability records, POCA-protected SAR data)
services.notes: Resolves SSC-001. Dual-mode API: synchronous short-path (retail, sub-1s) and asynchronous long-path (corporate EDD, multi-day). Publishes KYCClearanceGranted event. Single MLRO-owned KYC policy for all customer segments. Consumed by SVC-001, SVC-005, SVC-016.

services.name: Sanctions Screening Service
services.api_style: gRPC (real-time synchronous screening) + REST/OpenAPI (batch rescreening management)
services.data_store: In-memory screening engine (sub-200ms) + PostgreSQL (screening decision audit log)
services.notes: Resolves SSC-002. Hard blocking for SVC-009, SVC-010, SVC-006, SVC-050. No graceful degradation permitted (OFSI liability per Starling £29m enforcement, Oct 2024). Active-active multi-region deployment required. OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN lists. ComplyAdvantage/Refinitiv data providers.

services.name: Credit Decision Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (credit decision log, model version registry) + Data Platform (SVC-104) for bureau data inputs
services.data_residency: UK only (PRA IRB model data, credit bureau RBUA)
services.notes: Resolves SSC-003. Versioned credit model API — PRA IRB model changes require notification/approval. CRO SM&CR accountability for all model outputs. Dual-mode: synchronous real-time (retail, sub-second) and asynchronous batch (SME > £250k). Consumer Duty GDPR Article 22 automated decision records. Buy candidate: Experian PowerCurve.

services.name: Notification Service
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (communication preferences, consent state, delivery audit log)
services.data_residency: UK only (UK GDPR consent and preference records)
services.notes: Resolves SSC-005. Event-driven: subscribes to domain events across all capabilities. GDPR/PECR consent enforcement (marketing opt-out vs regulated communications). Regulated communications (MCOB, CONC, fraud alerts) delivered regardless of marketing consent. Buy: Twilio/MessageBird for delivery layer. Bank owns orchestration and consent logic.

services.name: Document Management Service
services.data_store: AWS S3 with Intelligent Tiering (object storage) + PostgreSQL (document metadata, classification, retention policy)
services.data_residency: UK only (regulated financial documents and personal data)
services.notes: Resolves SSC-004. ETDA 2023 electronic trade document storage. Regulatory retention periods enforced by document type (MLR 2017: 5 years; PRA financial records: 7 years). UK GDPR right-to-erasure conflict resolution policy. Consumed by SVC-050, SVC-002, SVC-006, SVC-014. Buy candidate: AWS S3 + Macie.

services.name: Workflow Engine
services.data_store: PostgreSQL (durable workflow state, task queue)
services.notes: Resolves SSC-006. Durable workflow execution for: corporate EDD (multi-day), mortgage origination (AIP → legal completion), trade finance (LC issuance → document examination), commercial credit committee. Maker-checker and approval chains for SM&CR accountability. Buy candidate: Temporal / Camunda.

services.name: Identity & Access Management
services.data_store: Managed IAM datastore (ForgeRock Identity Cloud / Okta Auth0 SaaS) — UK-hosted
services.data_residency: UK only (customer credential data, employee identity records)
services.notes: SCA-compliant authentication (PSD2 RTS). TPP certificate validation for Open Banking FAPI. RBAC/ABAC for SM&CR role assignments. SSO across internal applications (SAML 2.0 / OIDC). DIATF relying party for UK digital identity. Buy candidate: ForgeRock Identity Platform (preferred) / Okta Auth0. Must be active-active multi-zone — no single point of failure.

services.name: API Gateway
services.api_style: REST/OpenAPI (management API) — proxies all API styles
services.data_store: Managed API Gateway datastore (Apigee / AWS API Gateway managed service) + Redis (rate limit counters)
services.data_residency: UK — API call metadata and analytics
services.notes: External and internal API management. Rate limiting, TLS termination, FAPI compliance for Open Banking. CMA Open Banking performance reporting. Developer portal for TPPs. Buy candidate: Google Apigee (preferred) / AWS API Gateway / Kong.

services.name: Event Bus
services.api_style: Kafka Protocol (pub-sub) — schema registry over REST/OpenAPI
services.data_store: Confluent Cloud / AWS MSK (managed Kafka) — UK-hosted. Schema Registry for event contract governance.
services.data_residency: UK only (financial events may contain PII)
services.notes: Primary async integration mechanism between domain services. Schema versioning mandatory: backward-compatible for minimum 2 versions (SDD-008). Financial event replay capability for PRA supervisory investigation. Buy candidate: Confluent Cloud managed Kafka (preferred) / AWS MSK.

services.name: Audit & Logging
services.api_style: REST/OpenAPI (SIEM query API and audit export API)
services.data_store: Splunk Enterprise Security / Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) + cryptographically sealed log store. PCI DSS requires 12-month online, 12-month offline retention.
services.data_residency: UK only (audit logs contain PII, financial data, MLRO-protected SAR metadata)
services.notes: Immutable append-only audit log. SIEM with real-time correlation and alerting. MLR 2017: 5-year AML record minimum. PRA: 7-year financial records. SM&CR conduct evidence. PCI DSS cardholder data access logs. UK GDPR ROPA inputs. Buy candidate: Splunk Enterprise Security (preferred).

services.name: Data Platform
services.data_store: Databricks Lakehouse (Delta Lake) / Snowflake — UK-hosted. Feature store for ML models.
services.data_residency: UK only (consolidated customer and financial data)
services.notes: Enterprise data lake and warehouse. Feature store for SVC-013 (fraud ML), SVC-052 (credit ML), SVC-014 (AML ML). Only system permitted to query across domain service data for analytics (SDD-009). COREP/FINREP regulatory return data derivation. Consumer Duty outcomes analytics. Buy candidate: Databricks Lakehouse Platform (preferred).

services.name: Secrets Management
services.data_store: HashiCorp Vault Enterprise / AWS Secrets Manager + CloudHSM (UK-hosted hardware HSM)
services.data_residency: UK only (cryptographic key material must not leave UK jurisdiction)
services.notes: HSM-backed key storage. Automatic secrets rotation. Dynamic short-lived credentials (no long-lived database passwords). PCI DSS key management requirements. GDPR encryption key lifecycle. Buy candidate: HashiCorp Vault Enterprise (preferred, cloud-agnostic) / AWS Secrets Manager + KMS.

services.name: Service Mesh
services.api_style: gRPC (Envoy xDS control plane) — transparent to application services
services.data_store: Etcd (Istio control plane state) — ephemeral; no persistent business data
services.data_residency: N/A — infrastructure layer, no application data stored
services.notes: mTLS for all service-to-service calls. Deny-all baseline with explicit allow-list (SDD-010). SPIFFE/SPIRE service identity. PCI DSS network segmentation evidence. FCA operational resilience service dependency mapping. Buy candidate: Istio (preferred, CNCF graduated) / Linkerd.

services.name: OTel Collector
services.api_style: OTLP gRPC (OpenTelemetry protocol — not an external API)
services.data_store: Stateless — routes telemetry to SVC-108, SVC-109, SVC-110, SVC-111
services.data_residency: UK only — telemetry data may contain PII in log fields
services.notes: OpenTelemetry Collector gateway/sidecar pattern. Receives traces, metrics, and logs from all containerised services via OTLP. Processes (sampling, filtering, PII scrubbing) and routes to observability stores. Deployed alongside T0 platform services — observability from Day 1 per ADD-005. Open source (CNCF graduated).

services.name: Log Store
services.data_store: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch — UK-hosted, 90-day hot tier + cold tier archive
services.notes: Centralised structured log storage. Receives log streams from SVC-107. Query interface for incident investigation. Feeds SVC-112 (Observability Aggregator) for alerting. Separate from SVC-111 (WORM Audit Log Store) — general operational logs vs regulatory compliance records.

services.name: Trace Store
services.data_store: Jaeger (Cassandra backend) / Grafana Tempo (object storage) — UK-hosted, 30-day retention
services.notes: Distributed trace storage. Receives traces from SVC-107. Enables end-to-end latency analysis across service boundaries. Critical for FCA operational resilience important business service root-cause tracing and impact tolerance measurement. Feeds SVC-112 for SLA alerting.

services.name: Metrics Store
services.data_store: Prometheus / Thanos — UK-hosted. 15-day hot Prometheus retention + 13-month Thanos long-term store.
services.notes: Time-series metrics storage. Receives metrics from SVC-107. Feeds SVC-112 (Observability Aggregator) for SLA alerting and PRA operational resilience reporting. Prometheus is open source (CNCF graduated); Thanos adds long-term storage and high-availability.

services.name: Audit Log Store (WORM)
services.api_style: REST/OpenAPI (read-only query API — write is append-only, no update/delete)
services.data_store: Write-Once Read-Many immutable store — AWS S3 Object Lock / Azure Blob immutable storage, WORM-compliant. 7-year minimum retention.
services.data_residency: UK only (contains PII, financial data, MLRO SAR metadata)
services.notes: Regulatory-grade tamper-evident audit records. Receives from SVC-103 (Audit & Logging) for all regulated events (payments, KYC decisions, credit decisions, sanctions screening results, SM&CR accountability events). Cryptographic sealing prevents tampering post-write. Separate from SVC-108 (operational logs) — WORM only for regulatory compliance records. PRA 7-year financial records minimum.

services.name: Observability Aggregator
services.data_store: Grafana (stateless — queries SVC-108, SVC-109, SVC-110) + PostgreSQL (alert configuration)
services.notes: Dashboards, alerting, and SLA monitoring aggregating from SVC-108/109/110. Single pane-of-glass for IT Operations (PER-060). Important business service impact tolerance dashboards for FCA PS21/3 compliance. Feeds PRA operational resilience self-assessment data. CMA Open Banking API performance dashboard. Buy candidate: Grafana Enterprise.

services.name: Zero-Trust Policy Engine
services.api_style: REST/OpenAPI (OPA policy evaluation API) + gRPC (high-throughput policy checks)
services.data_store: OPA / Styra DAS — in-memory policy evaluation with PostgreSQL for policy version history
services.notes: Centralised policy decision point (PDP) implementing zero-trust authorisation across all services. Evaluates policy-as-code referencing IAM attributes (SVC-100), service mesh identity (SVC-106), risk signals from SVC-013, and SM&CR function attributes. Enables declarative governance for privileged access, PCI DSS CDE access decisions, and MLRO-gated data access. OPA (Open Policy Agent) is CNCF graduated. Styra DAS for policy lifecycle management.

by_tier.note: Original brief specified 30 services (17 domain + 6 cross-cutting + 7 foundation) plus 7 new observability/security services = 37 total. Tiers assigned per service-dependencies.json.

by_sla.rationale: 99.99% for payments/cards (direct revenue and regulatory liability); 99.999% for foundation platform (all services depend on these); 99.95% for core banking and digital channels (FCA important business service); 99.9%+ for compliance-critical services

by_api_style.note: gRPC used for sub-100ms real-time paths: fraud detection, sanctions screening, card authorisation, merchant authorisation, and card processing. All other services use REST/OpenAPI.

summary.services_with_uk_only_data_residency: All 37 services — no cross-border data transfer for UK customer data

highest_fan_in_services.note: SVC-009, SVC-010, SVC-006, SVC-050, SVC-005 all hard-block on sanctions

highest_fan_in_services.name: Fraud Detection Service
highest_fan_in_services.note: SVC-009, SVC-010, SVC-011, SVC-008, SVC-003 all hard-block on fraud scoring

highest_fan_in_services.note: SVC-001, SVC-002, SVC-003, SVC-005, SVC-016 require KYC clearance

most_critical_hard_dependency_chains: Payment execution: SVC-017/CH-001 → SVC-101 → SVC-009 → [SVC-051 gRPC, SVC-013 gRPC] → Vocalink/FPS
Card authorisation: Visa/CH-008 → SVC-011 → [SVC-013 gRPC sub-100ms] → approve/decline
Customer onboarding: Any channel → SVC-050 → SVC-051 → KYCClearanceGranted → SVC-001/SVC-005/SVC-016
